words.word: There’s a big message in something
words.definition: Used to say that a story, film, or situation contains an important moral, lesson, or deeper meaning.
words.definitionUz: Hikoya, film yoki vaziyatda muhim axloqiy saboq yoki chuqurroq ma’no borligini bildiradi.
words.translation: Biror narsada katta ma’no / saboq bor
words.example1: There’s a big message in this movie about kindness.
words.example1Translation: Bu filmda mehribonlik haqida katta ma’no bor.
words.example2: There’s a big message in her speech about hard work.
words.example2Translation: Uning nutqida mehnat haqida katta saboq bor.
words.example3: There’s a big message in the story about friendship.
words.example3Translation: Hikoyada do‘stlik haqida katta ma’no bor.
extraExamples: There’s a big message in this book for young people.
There’s a big message in the ending of the film.
There’s a big message in what he said yesterday.
There’s a big message in this song about hope.
There’s a big message in their actions.
There’s a big message in the way she handled the situation.
There’s a big message in this advertisement.
extraExampleTranslations: Bu kitobda yoshlar uchun katta ma’no bor.
Filmning oxirida katta saboq bor.
U kecha aytgan gapida katta ma’no bor.
Bu qo‘shiqda umid haqida katta ma’no bor.
Ularning harakatlarida katta ma’no bor.
U vaziyatni qanday hal qilganida katta saboq bor.
Bu reklamada katta ma’no bor.

words.definition: To bring information or experiences from the past back into your mind; to not forget.
words.definitionUz: O‘tmishdagi ma’lumot yoki tajribalarni xotiraga qaytarish; unutmaslik.
words.example1: Remember to lock the door before you leave.
words.example1Translation: Ketishdan oldin eshikni qulflashni unutma.
words.example2: I can’t remember her name.
words.example2Translation: Uning ismini eslay olmayapman.
words.example3: Do you remember the first time we met?
words.example3Translation: Birinchi marta uchrashganimizni eslaysizmi?
extraExamples: Remember what I told you yesterday.
She still remembers her childhood clearly.
Please remember to call me later.
I remember seeing that movie years ago.
Remember to bring your passport.
He doesn’t remember anything about the accident.
Always remember to be kind.
extraExampleTranslations: Kecha aytganlarimni eslab qol.
U hali ham bolaligini aniq eslaydi.
Iltimos, keyinroq menga qo‘ng‘iroq qilishni unutma.
O‘sha filmni yillar oldin ko‘rganimni eslayman.
Pasportingizni olib kelishni unutmang.
U baxtsiz hodisa haqida hech narsani eslamaydi.
Har doim mehribon bo‘lishni eslab qoling.

words.definition: To feel satisfaction and pleasure because of something you or someone else has done or achieved.
words.definitionUz: O‘zingiz yoki boshqa birov qilgan ish yoki erishgan yutuqdan mamnunlik va faxr his qilish.
words.example1: I’m so proud of my daughter for graduating.
words.example1Translation: Qizimning bitirganidan juda faxrlanaman.
words.example2: You should be proud of yourself for working so hard.
words.example2Translation: Bunchalik mehnat qilganingiz uchun o‘zingizdan faxrlanishingiz kerak.
words.example3: Parents are usually proud of their children’s achievements.
words.example3Translation: Ota-onalar odatda farzandlarining yutuqlaridan faxrlanadilar.
extraExamples: He is proud of his new job.
Be proud of how far you’ve come.
She felt proud of her team’s performance.
I’m proud of the way you handled that situation.
They are proud of their cultural heritage.
You can be proud of this result.
Don’t forget to be proud of small victories.
extraExampleTranslations: U yangi ishidan faxrlanadi.
Qancha yo‘l bosganingizdan faxrlaning.
U jamoasining chiqishidan faxrlandi.
U vaziyatni qanday hal qilganingizdan faxrlanaman.
Ular o‘z madaniy merosidan faxrlanadilar.
Bu natijadan faxrlanishingiz mumkin.
Kichik g‘alabalardan ham faxrlanishni unutmang.

words.definition: Used to introduce the topic or area that is being discussed or considered.
words.definitionUz: Muhokama qilinayotgan yoki ko‘rib chiqilayotgan mavzu yoki sohani kiritish uchun ishlatiladi.
words.example1: When it comes to cooking, she’s the best.
words.example1Translation: Oshxona ishlariga kelganda, u eng zo‘ri.
words.example2: When it comes to sports, I prefer football.
words.example2Translation: Sportga kelganda, men futbolni afzal ko‘raman.
words.example3: He’s very careful when it comes to money.
words.example3Translation: Pulga kelganda u juda ehtiyotkor.
extraExamples: When it comes to technology, I’m not an expert.
When it comes to loyalty, she is unmatched.
When it comes to exams, he always studies hard.
When it comes to fashion, she has great taste.
When it comes to problem-solving, he’s brilliant.
When it comes to time management, I need improvement.
When it comes to honesty, never compromise.
extraExampleTranslations: Texnologiyaga kelganda, men mutaxassis emasman.
Sadoqatga kelganda, unga teng keladigan yo‘q.
Imtihonlarga kelganda, u har doim qattiq o‘qiydi.
Modaga kelganda, uning didi a’lo.
Muammolarni hal qilishga kelganda, u zo‘r.
Vaqtni boshqarishga kelganda, meni rivojlantirish kerak.
Halollikka kelganda, hech qachon murosa qilmang.

words.definition: A series of three related books, films, or other works that form a continuous story or theme.
words.definitionUz: Uzluksiz hikoya yoki mavzuni tashkil etuvchi uchta bog‘liq kitob, film yoki boshqa asarlar turkumi.
words.example1: The Lord of the Rings is a famous trilogy.
words.example1Translation: Uzuklar hukmdori mashhur trilogiya.
words.example2: She is writing a trilogy of fantasy novels.
words.example2Translation: U fantastik romanlar trilogiyasini yozmoqda.
words.example3: The second part of the trilogy was the best.
words.example3Translation: Trilogiyaning ikkinchi qismi eng yaxshisi edi.
extraExamples: I just finished reading the whole trilogy.
They announced a new superhero trilogy.
This film is the final chapter of the trilogy.
The original trilogy is still popular today.
He directed all three films in the trilogy.
Fans are waiting for the third book in the trilogy.
The trilogy explores themes of friendship and courage.
extraExampleTranslations: Men butun trilogiyani o‘qib tugatdim.
Ular yangi superqahramon trilogiyasini e’lon qilishdi.
Bu film trilogiyaning so‘nggi qismi.
Asl trilogiya bugungi kunda ham mashhur.
U trilogiyadagi uchala filmni ham suratga oldi.
Muxlislar trilogiyaning uchinchi kitobini kutmoqda.
Trilogiya do‘stlik va jasorat mavzularini o‘rganadi.

words.word: What I love so much is that
words.pronunciation: /wɒt aɪ lʌv səʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðæt/
words.definition: Used to introduce something that the speaker particularly likes or appreciates about a situation or person.
words.definitionUz: So‘zlovchi biror vaziyat yoki odamda ayniqsa yoqtiradigan yoki qadrlaydigan narsani kiritish uchun ishlatiladi.
words.example1: What I love so much is that the characters feel real.
words.example1Translation: Men eng yoqtiradigan narsa shuki, qahramonlar haqiqiy tuyuladi.
words.example2: What I love so much is that everyone helps each other.
words.example2Translation: Men eng yoqtiradigan narsa shuki, hamma bir-biriga yordam beradi.
words.example3: What I love so much is that the story has a happy ending.
words.example3Translation: Men eng yoqtiradigan narsa shuki, hikoya baxtli yakun bilan tugaydi.
extraExamples: What I love so much is that the music fits perfectly.
What I love so much is that she never gives up.
What I love so much is that the food is always fresh.
What I love so much is that we can talk about anything.
What I love so much is that the design is so simple.
What I love so much is that it feels authentic.
What I love so much is that the community is supportive.
extraExampleTranslations: Men eng yoqtiradigan narsa shuki, musiqa mukammal mos keladi.
Men eng yoqtiradigan narsa shuki, u hech qachon taslim bo‘lmaydi.
Men eng yoqtiradigan narsa shuki, ovqat har doim yangi.
Men eng yoqtiradigan narsa shuki, biz hamma narsa haqida gaplasha olamiz.
Men eng yoqtiradigan narsa shuki, dizayn juda oddiy.
Men eng yoqtiradigan narsa shuki, u haqiqiy tuyuladi.
Men eng yoqtiradigan narsa shuki, jamoa qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi.

words.definition: A series of related films, books, or other products that share the same characters, setting, or brand; also a business model where one operates under another company’s brand.
words.definitionUz: Bir xil qahramonlar, muhit yoki brendga ega bo‘lgan bog‘liq filmlar, kitoblar yoki boshqa mahsulotlar turkumi; shuningdek, boshqa kompaniya brendi ostida ishlash biznes modeli.
words.example1: The Marvel franchise is extremely popular worldwide.
words.example1Translation: Marvel franshizasi butun dunyoda juda mashhur.
words.example2: He owns a successful fast-food franchise.
words.example2Translation: U muvaffaqiyatli tez ovqatlanish franshizasiga egadir.
words.example3: This movie is part of a huge action franchise.
words.example3Translation: Bu film ulkan jangari franshizaning bir qismi.
extraExamples: Fans can’t wait for the next film in the franchise.
The franchise has made billions of dollars.
She bought a coffee shop franchise last year.
This video game franchise has been around for decades.
The studio is planning to expand the franchise.
Managing a franchise requires a lot of work.
The original franchise started in the 1970s.
extraExampleTranslations: Muxlislar franshizaning keyingi filmini sabrsizlik bilan kutmoqda.
Franshiza milliardlab dollar ishlab topdi.
U o‘tgan yili qahva do‘koni franshizasini sotib oldi.
Bu video o‘yin franshizasi o‘nlab yillardan beri mavjud.
Studiya franshizani kengaytirishni rejalashtirmoqda.
Franshizani boshqarish ko‘p mehnat talab qiladi.
Asl franshiza 1970-yillarda boshlangan.

words.definition: To completely change or reverse the usual way of thinking about or doing something.
words.definitionUz: Biror narsa haqida odatdagi fikrlash yoki qilish usulini butunlay o‘zgartirish yoki teskari qilish.
words.translation: Biror narsani tubdan o‘zgartirmoq / teskari qilib qo‘ymoq
words.example1: The new discovery flipped the old theory on its head.
words.example1Translation: Yangi kashfiyot eski nazariyani tubdan o‘zgartirdi.
words.example2: She flipped the traditional approach on its head.
words.example2Translation: U an’anaviy yondashuvni butunlay teskari qildi.
words.example3: This idea flips the whole industry on its head.
words.example3Translation: Bu g‘oya butun sanoatni tubdan o‘zgartiradi.
extraExamples: The ending of the movie flipped everything on its head.
He flipped the argument on its head with one question.
Technology is flipping education on its head.
They flipped the usual marketing strategy on its head.
This research flips previous assumptions on their head.
The design flips the classic style on its head.
She managed to flip the situation on its head.
extraExampleTranslations: Filmning oxiri hamma narsani tubdan o‘zgartirdi.
U bitta savol bilan bahsni teskari qildi.
Texnologiya ta’limni tubdan o‘zgartirmoqda.
Ular odatiy marketing strategiyasini teskari qildilar.
Bu tadqiqot oldingi taxminlarni tubdan o‘zgartiradi.
Dizayn klassik uslubni teskari qilib qo‘ydi.
U vaziyatni tubdan o‘zgartirishga muvaffaq bo‘ldi.

words.definition: To remove something from a larger whole, or to extract meaning, value, or enjoyment from a situation.
words.definitionUz: Biror narsani kattaroq butundan olib tashlash yoki vaziyatdan ma’no, qimmat yoki zavq olish.
words.translation: Biror narsadan biror narsani olib tashlamoq / chiqarib olmoq
words.example1: Please take the keys out of the bag.
words.example1Translation: Iltimos, kalitlarni sumkadan olib tashlang.
words.example2: I try to take something positive out of every experience.
words.example2Translation: Men har bir tajribadan ijobiy narsa olishga harakat qilaman.
words.example3: Don’t take the fun out of the game.
words.example3Translation: O‘yindan zavqni olib tashlamang.
extraExamples: She took the money out of her pocket.
He took a lot of lessons out of that failure.
Take the trash out of the kitchen.
I took great satisfaction out of helping them.
They took the best parts out of the original story.
Don’t take the meaning out of context.
You can take a lot of wisdom out of this book.
extraExampleTranslations: U cho‘ntagidan pulni oldi.
U o‘sha muvaffaqiyatsizlikdan ko‘p saboq oldi.
Axlatni oshxonadan olib tashlang.
Ularga yordam berishdan katta mamnunlik oldim.
Ular asl hikoyadan eng yaxshi qismlarni oldilar.
Ma’noni kontekstdan ajratib olmang.
Bu kitobdan ko‘p donolik olishingiz mumkin.

words.definition: The quality of being significant, valuable, or necessary; the degree to which something matters.
words.definitionUz: Muhim, qimmatli yoki zarur bo‘lish sifati; biror narsaning qanchalik ahamiyatli ekanligi.
words.example1: The importance of education cannot be overstated.
words.example1Translation: Ta’limning ahamiyatini haddan tashqari oshirib bo‘lmaydi.
words.example2: We discussed the importance of teamwork.
words.example2Translation: Biz jamoaviy ishning ahamiyatini muhokama qildik.
words.example3: She understands the importance of honesty.
words.example3Translation: U halollikning ahamiyatini tushunadi.
extraExamples: The importance of sleep is often ignored.
He stressed the importance of regular exercise.
Many people underestimate the importance of mental health.
The importance of this discovery is huge.
Parents teach children the importance of respect.
We cannot forget the importance of family.
The importance of clear communication is obvious.
extraExampleTranslations: Uyqu ahamiyati ko‘pincha e’tiborsiz qoldiriladi.
U muntazam jismoniy mashqlar ahamiyatini ta’kidladi.
Ko‘p odamlar ruhiy salomatlik ahamiyatini kam baholaydi.
Bu kashfiyotning ahamiyati juda katta.
Ota-onalar bolalarga hurmat ahamiyatini o‘rgatadilar.
Oilaviy ahamiyatni unutib bo‘lmaydi.
Aniq muloqot ahamiyati aniq.

words.definition: A group of people living in the same place or having a particular characteristic in common; a feeling of fellowship.
words.definitionUz: Bir joyda yashovchi yoki umumiy xususiyatga ega odamlar guruhi; hamjihatlik hissi.
words.example1: Our community organized a clean-up day.
words.example1Translation: Bizning jamoamiz tozalash kunini tashkil qildi.
words.example2: She feels a strong sense of community here.
words.example2Translation: U bu yerda kuchli jamoaviylik hissini his qiladi.
words.example3: The online community helped him a lot.
words.example3Translation: Onlayn jamoa unga juda yordam berdi.
extraExamples: Building a supportive community takes time.
The local community welcomed the newcomers.
He is an active member of the community.
Community events bring people together.
We need to protect our community’s values.
The artist community is very creative.
A strong community can overcome many challenges.
extraExampleTranslations: Qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi jamoa yaratish vaqt talab qiladi.
Mahalliy jamoa yangi kelganlarni kutib oldi.
U jamoaning faol a’zosi.
Jamoa tadbirlari odamlarni birlashtiradi.
Biz jamoamizning qadriyatlarini himoya qilishimiz kerak.
Rassomlar jamoasi juda ijodiy.
Kuchli jamoa ko‘p qiyinchiliklarni yengib o‘ta oladi.

words.definition: To request assistance or support from someone when you need it.
words.definitionUz: Kerak bo‘lganda kimdandir yordam yoki qo‘llab-quvvatlash so‘rash.
words.example1: Don’t be afraid to ask for help if you need it.
words.example1Translation: Agar kerak bo‘lsa, yordam so‘rashdan qo‘rqmang.
words.example2: She finally asked for help with the project.
words.example2Translation: U nihoyat loyiha bo‘yicha yordam so‘radi.
words.example3: It’s okay to ask for help when things get difficult.
words.example3Translation: Ishlar qiyinlashganda yordam so‘rash normal.
extraExamples: He was too proud to ask for help.
Students should ask for help when they don’t understand.
I asked for help moving the furniture.
Never hesitate to ask for help from friends.
She asked for help finding a new job.
Asking for help is a sign of strength, not weakness.
They asked for help from the local authorities.
extraExampleTranslations: U yordam so‘rash uchun juda mag‘rur edi.
Talabalar tushunmaganda yordam so‘rashlari kerak.
Men mebellarni ko‘chirishda yordam so‘radim.
Do‘stlardan yordam so‘rashdan hech qachon ikkilanmang.
U yangi ish topishda yordam so‘radi.
Yordam so‘rash zaiflik emas, kuch belgisidir.
Ular mahalliy hokimiyatlardan yordam so‘radilar.

words.definition: To be extremely good at something; to do something better than others.
words.definitionUz: Biror narsada juda zo‘r bo‘lish; boshqalardan yaxshiroq qilish.
words.example1: She excels at mathematics.
words.example1Translation: U matematikada zo‘r.
words.example2: He wants to excel in his career.
words.example2Translation: U karyerasida zo‘r bo‘lishni xohlaydi.
words.example3: The team excelled in the final match.
words.example3Translation: Jamoa final o‘yinida zo‘r chiqdi.
extraExamples: Students who excel often get scholarships.
She excels in both sports and academics.
If you want to excel, you need discipline.
He excelled as a leader during the crisis.
Many people excel under pressure.
The company excels at customer service.
Children can excel when they feel supported.
extraExampleTranslations: Zo‘r o‘qiydigan talabalar ko‘pincha stipendiya oladilar.
U ham sportda, ham o‘qishda zo‘r.
Agar zo‘r bo‘lishni xohlasangiz, intizom kerak.
U inqiroz paytida yetakchi sifatida zo‘r chiqdi.
Ko‘p odamlar bosim ostida zo‘r ishlaydi.
Kompaniya mijozlarga xizmat ko‘rsatishda zo‘r.
Bolalar qo‘llab-quvvatlanganini his qilganda zo‘r bo‘lishlari mumkin.

words.definition: To spend the entire day outside the home, usually doing activities or being busy.
words.definitionUz: Butun kunni uy tashqarisida o‘tkazish, odatda faoliyat bilan band bo‘lish.
words.example1: I was out all day running errands.
words.example1Translation: Men butun kun tashqarida yurib, ishlar bilan band edim.
words.example2: The kids were out all day playing in the park.
words.example2Translation: Bolalar butun kun parkda o‘ynab yurishdi.
words.example3: She was out all day and came home exhausted.
words.example3Translation: U butun kun tashqarida bo‘lib, uyga charchagan holda qaytdi.
extraExamples: We were out all day shopping and sightseeing.
He is usually out all day at work.
Don’t expect me home early — I’ll be out all day.
The dog was out all day in the garden.
They were out all day exploring the city.
Being out all day in the sun made me tired.
I prefer not to be out all day when it’s raining.
extraExampleTranslations: Biz butun kun xarid qilib va diqqatga sazovor joylarni ko‘rib yurdik.
U odatda butun kun ishda tashqarida bo‘ladi.
Meni erta kutmang — men butun kun tashqarida bo‘laman.
It butun kun bog‘da tashqarida edi.
Ular butun kun shaharni kashf qilib yurishdi.
Butun kun quyoshda tashqarida bo‘lish meni charchatdi.
Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotganda butun kun tashqarida bo‘lishni yoqtirmayman.

words.definition: A heroic character who hides their identity by wearing a mask, often in comics, films, or stories.
words.definitionUz: O‘z shaxsini niqob kiyib yashiradigan qahramon, odatda komikslar, filmlar yoki hikoyalarda.
words.example1: Batman is a classic masked hero.
words.example1Translation: Betmen klassik niqobli qahramon.
words.example2: Children love stories about masked heroes.
words.example2Translation: Bolalar niqobli qahramonlar haqidagi hikoyalarni yaxshi ko‘radilar.
words.example3: The masked hero saved the city once again.
words.example3Translation: Niqobli qahramon shaharni yana bir bor qutqardi.
extraExamples: Every superhero movie needs a good masked hero.
He dreamed of becoming a masked hero.
The masked hero disappeared into the night.
Fans waited for the return of their favorite masked hero.
A new masked hero appeared in the latest comic.
She cosplayed as a famous masked hero.
The identity of the masked hero was finally revealed.
extraExampleTranslations: Har bir superqahramon filmida yaxshi niqobli qahramon bo‘lishi kerak.
U niqobli qahramon bo‘lishni orzu qilardi.
Niqobli qahramon tunga g‘oyib bo‘ldi.
Muxlislar sevimli niqobli qahramonlarining qaytishini kutishdi.
Eng so‘nggi komiksda yangi niqobli qahramon paydo bo‘ldi.
U mashhur niqobli qahramon sifatida kospley qildi.
Niqobli qahramonning shaxsi nihoyat oshkor bo‘ldi.

words.definition: To spend a long time continuously scrolling through negative or depressing news and content on social media or the internet.
words.definitionUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar yoki internetda salbiy yoki tushkunlikka soluvchi yangiliklar va kontentni uzoq vaqt uzluksiz varaqлаб o‘tirish.
words.example1: I spent the whole evening doom scrolling through the news.
words.example1Translation: Men butun kechqurun yangiliklarni varaqлаб o‘tirdim.
words.example2: Stop doom scrolling through social media before bed.
words.example2Translation: Yotishdan oldin ijtimoiy tarmoqlarni varaqлаб o‘tirmang.
words.example3: She realized she was doom scrolling through bad news again.
words.example3Translation: U yana yomon yangiliklarni varaqлаб o‘tirganini angladi.
extraExamples: Doom scrolling through Twitter made me anxious.
I caught myself doom scrolling for hours.
Many people doom scroll through negative content daily.
He tried to quit doom scrolling through the news.
Doom scrolling late at night is a bad habit.
After doom scrolling, I felt worse than before.
Put the phone down and stop doom scrolling.
extraExampleTranslations: Twitterni varaqлаб o‘tirish meni xavotirga soldi.
O‘zimni soatlab varaqлаб o‘tirganimni payqadim.
Ko‘p odamlar har kuni salbiy kontentni varaqлаб o‘tiradilar.
U yangiliklarni varaqлаб o‘tirishni tashlashga harakat qildi.
Kechqurun kech soatlarda varaqлаб o‘tirish yomon odat.
Varaqлаб o‘tirgandan keyin o‘zimni oldingidan yomonroq his qildim.
Telefonni qo‘ying va varaqлаб o‘tirishni to‘xtating.

words.definition: To act or function in a particular role or capacity; to be used for a specific purpose.
words.definitionUz: Muayyan rol yoki qobiliyatda ishlash; maxsus maqsad uchun ishlatilish.
words.translation: Sifatida xizmat qilmoq / bo‘lib xizmat qilmoq
words.example1: This room can serve as a guest bedroom.
words.example1Translation: Bu xona mehmon xonasi sifatida xizmat qilishi mumkin.
words.example2: She served as the team captain for two years.
words.example2Translation: U ikki yil jamoa kapitani sifatida xizmat qildi.
words.example3: The old building now serves as a museum.
words.example3Translation: Eski bino endi muzey sifatida xizmat qilmoqda.
extraExamples: His experience will serve as a valuable lesson.
This example can serve as a model for others.
The park serves as a meeting place for the community.
She served as a mentor to many young artists.
The data will serve as evidence in the case.
This song serves as the theme for the movie.
The bridge serves as an important connection between the two cities.
extraExampleTranslations: Uning tajribasi qimmatli saboq sifatida xizmat qiladi.
Bu misol boshqalar uchun namuna sifatida xizmat qilishi mumkin.
Park jamoa uchun uchrashuv joyi sifatida xizmat qiladi.
U ko‘p yosh rassomlarga mentor sifatida xizmat qildi.
Ma’lumotlar ishda dalil sifatida xizmat qiladi.
Bu qo‘shiq film uchun mavzu sifatida xizmat qiladi.
Ko‘prik ikki shahar o‘rtasida muhim bog‘lovchi sifatida xizmat qiladi.

words.word: A beacon of hope for somebody
words.definition: A person, thing, or idea that gives hope and inspiration to someone in a difficult situation.
words.definitionUz: Qiyin vaziyatda kimdir uchun umid va ilhom beradigan odam, narsa yoki g‘oya.
words.example1: Her success became a beacon of hope for many young women.
words.example1Translation: Uning muvaffaqiyati ko‘p yosh ayollar uchun umid chirog‘iga aylandi.
words.example2: The new school is a beacon of hope for the community.
words.example2Translation: Yangi maktab jamoa uchun umid chirog‘i.
words.example3: In dark times, he was a beacon of hope for his family.
words.example3Translation: Qorong‘u paytlarda u oilasi uchun umid chirog‘i edi.
extraExamples: The organization serves as a beacon of hope for refugees.
Her story is a beacon of hope for people facing illness.
This discovery is a beacon of hope for patients.
He became a beacon of hope after surviving the disaster.
The charity is a beacon of hope for homeless children.
In the middle of the crisis, she remained a beacon of hope.
Their kindness was a beacon of hope for everyone around.
extraExampleTranslations: Tashkilot qochqinlar uchun umid chirog‘i sifatida xizmat qiladi.
Uning hikoyasi kasallik bilan kurashayotganlar uchun umid chirog‘i.
Bu kashfiyot bemorlar uchun umid chirog‘i.
U ofatdan omon qolganidan keyin umid chirog‘iga aylandi.
Xayriya uy-joyisiz bolalar uchun umid chirog‘i.
Inqiroz o‘rtasida u umid chirog‘i bo‘lib qoldi.
Ularning mehribonligi atrofdagilar uchun umid chirog‘i edi.

words.definition: To share past experiences, relationships, or events with someone, often implying a long or meaningful connection.
words.definitionUz: Kimdir bilan o‘tmishdagi tajribalar, munosabatlar yoki voqealarni baham ko‘rish, ko‘pincha uzoq yoki mazmunli bog‘liqlikni anglatadi.
words.translation: Birgalikda o‘tmishga ega bo‘lmoq / birga tarixga ega bo‘lmoq
words.example1: We’ve known each other for years — we have a history together.
words.example1Translation: Biz bir-birimizni yillardan beri bilamiz — bizning birga tariximiz bor.
words.example2: Even though they broke up, they still have a history together.
words.example2Translation: Garchi ular ajrashgan bo‘lsalar ham, ularning birga tarixi bor.
words.example3: The two countries have a complicated history together.
words.example3Translation: Ikki davlatning murakkab birga tarixi bor.
extraExamples: They have a long history together as friends.
You can tell they have a history together from the way they talk.
We have a history together that goes back to childhood.
Despite the arguments, they have a history together.
The band members have a rich history together.
I don’t want to work with him — we have a history together.
Having a history together makes the relationship deeper.
extraExampleTranslations: Ular do‘st sifatida uzoq birga tarixga ega.
Ularning gapirish usulidan birga tarixga ega ekanliklarini bilish mumkin.
Bizning bolalikdan boshlab birga tariximiz bor.
Janjallarga qaramay, ularning birga tarixi bor.
Guruh a’zolarining boy birga tarixi bor.
U bilan ishlashni xohlamayman — bizning birga tariximiz bor.
Birga tarixga ega bo‘lish munosabatni chuqurlashtiradi.

words.definition: To quickly become friends or get along very well with someone when you first meet them.
words.definitionUz: Birinchi uchrashganda kimdir bilan tezda do‘st bo‘lish yoki juda yaxshi munosabat o‘rnatish.
words.example1: We hit it off immediately at the party.
words.example1Translation: Biz bayramda darhol til topishdik.
words.example2: I hope the new colleagues will hit it off.
words.example2Translation: Umid qilamanki, yangi hamkasblar til topishadi.
words.example3: They hit it off from the first conversation.
words.example3Translation: Ular birinchi suhbatdanoq til topishdilar.
extraExamples: I’m glad you two hit it off so well.
She hits it off with almost everyone she meets.
They didn’t hit it off at first, but later became friends.
We hit it off over a shared love of books.
It’s rare to hit it off so quickly with a stranger.
The kids hit it off and played all afternoon.
If you hit it off with the interviewer, you have a better chance.
extraExampleTranslations: Ikkalangizning shunchalik yaxshi til topishganingizdan xursandman.
U deyarli uchrashgan hamma bilan til topishadi.
Ular avvaliga til topisha olmadilar, lekin keyinroq do‘st bo‘lishdi.
Biz kitoblarga bo‘lgan umumiy muhabbat tufayli til topishdik.
Notanish odam bilan bunchalik tez til topishish kamdan-kam uchraydi.
Bolalar til topishib, butun tushdan keyin o‘ynashdi.
Agar suhbatdosh bilan til topishsangiz, imkoniyatingiz yuqori bo‘ladi.

words.definition: Without any delay; at once; right away.
words.definitionUz: Hech qanday kechikishsiz; darhol; hoziroq.
words.example1: Please call me immediately if there’s a problem.
words.example1Translation: Agar muammo bo‘lsa, menga darhol qo‘ng‘iroq qiling.
words.example2: She answered the question immediately.
words.example2Translation: U savolga darhol javob berdi.
words.example3: The ambulance arrived immediately after the call.
words.example3Translation: Tez yordam chaqiruvdan so‘ng darhol yetib keldi.
extraExamples: I need that report immediately.
He left the room immediately after the argument.
The medicine started working immediately.
Please respond to this email immediately.
She recognized him immediately.
The system shuts down immediately if there’s an error.
They started the project immediately after approval.
extraExampleTranslations: Menga o‘sha hisobot darhol kerak.
U janjaldan so‘ng darhol xonani tark etdi.
Dori darhol ta’sir qila boshladi.
Iltimos, bu elektron pochtaga darhol javob bering.
U uni darhol tanidi.
Agar xato bo‘lsa, tizim darhol o‘chadi.
Ular tasdiqlashdan so‘ng darhol loyihani boshladilar.

words.definition: To perform or present yourself in order to try to get a role in a play, film, or other performance.
words.definitionUz: Spektakl, film yoki boshqa spektaklda rol olish uchun chiqish qilish yoki o‘zingizni taqdim etish.
words.translation: Biror narsa uchun proba / tinglovdan o‘tmoq
words.example1: She is auditioning for the lead role in the play.
words.example1Translation: U spektakldagi bosh rol uchun proba topshirmoqda.
words.example2: Hundreds of people auditioned for the part.
words.example2Translation: Yuzlab odamlar rol uchun proba topshirdilar.
words.example3: He auditioned for the band last week.
words.example3Translation: U o‘tgan hafta guruh uchun proba topshirdi.
extraExamples: I have to audition for the school musical tomorrow.
She auditioned for several films before getting the role.
They are auditioning actors for the new series.
Don’t be nervous when you audition for the part.
He auditioned for the choir and got accepted.
Many talented people audition for these opportunities.
She practiced for weeks before auditioning for the role.
extraExampleTranslations: Ertaga maktab musiqali spektakli uchun proba topshiraman.
U rolni olishdan oldin bir necha film uchun proba topshirdi.
Ular yangi serial uchun aktyorlarni tanlamoqda.
Rol uchun proba topshirayotganda asabiylashmang.
U xor uchun proba topshirib, qabul qilindi.
Ko‘p iqtidorli odamlar bu imkoniyatlar uchun proba topshiradilar.
U rol uchun proba topshirishdan oldin haftalar davomida mashq qildi.

words.definition: A video recording that an actor makes of themselves performing a scene, usually submitted for an audition instead of attending in person.
words.definitionUz: Aktyor o‘zini sahna o‘ynab yozib olgan video, odatda shaxsan qatnashish o‘rniga proba uchun yuboriladi.
words.example1: I need to record a self tape for the audition.
words.example1Translation: Proba uchun o‘zimni yozib olishim kerak.
words.example2: She sent her self tape to the casting director.
words.example2Translation: U o‘z proba videosini kasting direktoriga yubordi.
words.example3: Self tapes have become very common in the industry.
words.example3Translation: O‘zini yozib olgan probalar sohada juda keng tarqaldi.
extraExamples: Make sure the lighting is good in your self tape.
He practiced the scene many times before filming the self tape.
The director watched hundreds of self tapes.
A good self tape can get you the role.
She learned how to make professional self tapes.
Self tapes allow actors to audition from anywhere.
I spent the whole day working on my self tape.
extraExampleTranslations: Proba videongizda yoritish yaxshi ekanligiga ishonch hosil qiling.
U proba videosini suratga olishdan oldin sahnani ko‘p marta mashq qildi.
Rejissyor yuzlab proba videolarini ko‘rdi.
Yaxshi proba videosi sizga rolni olib berishi mumkin.
U professional proba videolari yaratishni o‘rgandi.
Proba videolari aktyorlarga istalgan joydan proba topshirish imkonini beradi.
Men butun kunni proba videom ustida ishladim.

words.definition: Not being filmed or recorded; happening in real life rather than on screen.
words.definitionUz: Suratga olinmayotgan yoki yozib olinmayotgan; ekranda emas, real hayotda sodir bo‘layotgan.
words.example1: They are good friends off camera as well.
words.example1Translation: Ular kamera ortida ham yaxshi do‘stlar.
words.example2: Off camera, the actor is very quiet and shy.
words.example2Translation: Kamera ortida aktyor juda tinch va uyatchan.
words.example3: What happens off camera is often more interesting.
words.example3Translation: Kamera ortida sodir bo‘ladigan narsalar ko‘pincha qiziqarliroq.
extraExamples: Off camera, the team works very hard.
She is completely different off camera.
The chemistry between them is real, even off camera.
Off camera moments can reveal true personalities.
He prefers to keep his private life off camera.
Many funny things happen off camera during filming.
Off camera, they discussed the next scene.
extraExampleTranslations: Kamera ortida jamoa juda qattiq ishlaydi.
U kamera ortida butunlay boshqacha.
Ular o‘rtasidagi kimyo haqiqiy, hatto kamera ortida ham.
Kamera ortidagi lahzalar haqiqiy shaxslarni ochib berishi mumkin.
U shaxsiy hayotini kamera ortida saqlashni afzal ko‘radi.
Suratga olish paytida kamera ortida ko‘p kulgili narsalar sodir bo‘ladi.
Kamera ortida ular keyingi sahna haqida gaplashdilar.

words.definition: To appear in the same scene or shot on screen at the same time, especially in films or television.
words.definitionUz: Ayniqsa filmlar yoki televideniyeda bir vaqtda ekranda bir xil sahna yoki kadrda chiqish.
words.translation: Birga ekranda chiqmoq / birga suratga tushmoq
words.example1: It was exciting to finally share the screen together.
words.example1Translation: Nihoyat birga ekranda chiqish hayajonli edi.
words.example2: The two stars will share the screen together in the new film.
words.example2Translation: Ikki yulduz yangi filmda birga ekranda chiqadi.
words.example3: They haven’t shared the screen together for many years.
words.example3Translation: Ular ko‘p yillardan beri birga ekranda chiqishmagan.
extraExamples: Fans were happy to see them share the screen together again.
This is the first time the brothers will share the screen together.
They shared the screen together in several memorable scenes.
It was an honor to share the screen together with such talent.
The chemistry when they share the screen together is amazing.
We hope to share the screen together in future projects.
Sharing the screen together brought back old memories.
extraExampleTranslations: Muxlislar ularni yana birga ekranda ko‘rganidan xursand bo‘lishdi.
Bu aka-ukalarning birinchi marta birga ekranda chiqishi.
Ular bir necha unutilmas sahnalarda birga ekranda chiqishdi.
Bunday iste’dod bilan birga ekranda chiqish sharaf edi.
Ular birga ekranda chiqqanda kimyo ajoyib.
Kelajakdagi loyihalarda birga ekranda chiqishni umid qilamiz.
Birga ekranda chiqish eski xotiralarni eslatdi.

words.definition: An event, action, or object that clearly shows or embodies something abstract such as a feeling, idea, or quality; also the practice of bringing something into reality through focused thought or belief.
words.definitionUz: Hissiyot, g‘oya yoki sifat kabi mavhum narsani aniq ko‘rsatadigan yoki mujassamlashtiradigan voqea, harakat yoki obyekt; shuningdek, diqqatli fikr yoki e’tiqod orqali biror narsani haqiqatga aylantirish amaliyoti.
words.example1: His kindness is a manifestation of his good character.
words.example1Translation: Uning mehribonligi yaxshi xarakterining namoyonidir.
words.example2: Many people believe in the power of manifestation.
words.example2Translation: Ko‘p odamlar manifestation kuchiga ishonadilar.
words.example3: The protest was a manifestation of public anger.
words.example3Translation: Norozilik namoyishi jamoatchilik g‘azabining namoyoni edi.
extraExamples: She practices manifestation every morning.
Success can be a manifestation of hard work.
The symptoms are a manifestation of the disease.
Manifestation requires clear intention and belief.
Art is often a manifestation of inner emotions.
His achievement is a manifestation of years of effort.
They see the results as a manifestation of their goals.
extraExampleTranslations: U har kuni ertalab manifestation bilan shug‘ullanadi.
Muvaffaqiyat qattiq mehnatning namoyoni bo‘lishi mumkin.
Alomatlar kasallikning namoyonidir.
Manifestation aniq niyat va e’tiqodni talab qiladi.
San’at ko‘pincha ichki his-tuyg‘ularning namoyonidir.
Uning yutug‘i yillar davomidagi mehnatning namoyonidir.
Ular natijalarni o‘z maqsadlarining namoyoni deb biladilar.

words.definition: Used to emphasize how extreme, surprising, or noticeable something is (e.g., “Talk about hot!” meaning “It is extremely hot!”).
words.definitionUz: Biror hayratlanarli yoki yaqqol ko‘rinib turgan holatni ta’kidlash uchun ishlatiladi. Masalan, “Talk about hot!” desangiz, “Issiqni qarang-a!” degan bo‘lasiz.
words.example1: Talk about a surprise! I never expected that.
words.example1Translation: Qarang-a, qanday hayrat! Men buni kutmagandim.
words.example2: Talk about bad luck — he missed the bus by one second.
words.example2Translation: Qarang-a, qanday omadsizlik — u avtobusni bir soniya farq bilan o‘tkazib yubordi.
words.example3: Talk about delicious! This cake is amazing.
words.example3Translation: Qarang-a, qanday mazali! Bu tort ajoyib.
extraExamples: Talk about commitment — she practiced every single day.
Talk about a plot twist! Nobody saw that coming.
Talk about expensive! I can’t believe the price.
Talk about talent — the kid is only ten years old.
Talk about perfect timing!
Talk about a long day — I’m completely exhausted.
Talk about irony — the fire station burned down.
extraExampleTranslations: Qarang-a, qanday sadoqat — u har kuni mashq qildi.
Qarang-a, qanday syujet burilishi! Hech kim buni kutmagan.
Qarang-a, qanday qimmat! Narxiga ishonolmayman.
Qarang-a, qanday iste’dod — bola atigi o‘n yoshda.
Qarang-a, qanday mukammal vaqt!
Qarang-a, qanday uzun kun — men butunlay charchadim.
Qarang-a, qanday kinoya — yong‘in stansiyasi yonib ketdi.

words.definition: Used to ask someone to describe the experience or nature of something (e.g., “What’s it like living abroad?”).
words.definitionUz: Kimdir biror narsaning tajribasi yoki mohiyatini tasvirlab berishini so‘rash uchun ishlatiladi (masalan, “Xorijda yashash qanday?”).
words.example1: What’s it like living in a big city?
words.example1Translation: Katta shaharda yashash qanday?
words.example2: What’s it like working with famous actors?
words.example2Translation: Mashhur aktyorlar bilan ishlash qanday?
words.example3: What’s it like to be a parent?
words.example3Translation: Ota-ona bo‘lish qanday?
extraExamples: What’s it like studying abroad?
What’s it like waking up so early every day?
What’s it like performing on stage?
What’s it like having so many followers?
What’s it like traveling alone?
What’s it like to finally achieve your dream?
What’s it like living without the internet?
extraExampleTranslations: Xorijda o‘qish qanday?
Har kuni bunchalik erta uyg‘onish qanday?
Sahnada chiqish qanday?
Bunchalik ko‘p obunachiga ega bo‘lish qanday?
Yolg‘iz sayohat qilish qanday?
Nihoyat orzuyingizga erishish qanday?
Internetisiz yashash qanday?

words.definition: Fitting closely to the body; also used informally to mean excellent, cool, or well-executed; or describing a close relationship or limited time/money.
words.definitionUz: Tanga yaqin o‘tiradigan; norasmiy ravishda ajoyib, zo‘r yoki yaxshi bajarilgan degan ma’noda; yoki yaqin munosabat yoki cheklangan vaqt/pulni bildiradi.
words.example1: These jeans are too tight.
words.example1Translation: Bu jinsi shim juda tor.
words.example2: That performance was tight!
words.example2Translation: O‘sha chiqish zo‘r edi!
words.example3: We’re on a tight schedule this week.
words.example3Translation: Bu hafta jadvalimiz juda siqiq.
extraExamples: The deadline is tight, so we need to work fast.
They have a tight friendship.
The security was very tight at the event.
Money is tight this month.
That dance move was tight!
Keep a tight grip on the rope.
The team played a tight game.
extraExampleTranslations: Muddat siqiq, shuning uchun tez ishlashimiz kerak.
Ularning do‘stligi juda yaqin.
Tadbirda xavfsizlik juda qattiq edi.
Bu oy pul siqiq.
O‘sha raqs harakati zo‘r edi!
Arqonni mahkam ushlang.
Jamoa siqiq o‘yin o‘ynadi.

words.definition: To leave a place; to explode or make a sudden loud noise; to start speaking angrily or passionately; or (of food) to become bad.
words.definitionUz: Joyni tark etish; portlash yoki to‘satdan baland ovoz chiqarish; g‘azab yoki ehtiros bilan gapira boshlash; yoki (ovqat) buzilib ketish.
words.example1: I need to go off now — see you later.
words.example1Translation: Hozir ketishim kerak — keyinroq ko‘rishamiz.
words.example2: The alarm went off in the middle of the night.
words.example2Translation: Signal tungi o‘rtada ishladi.
words.example3: She went off on a long rant about the problem.
words.example3Translation: U muammo haqida uzoq vaqt gapira boshladi.
extraExamples: The milk has gone off — don’t drink it.
He went off to college last year.
The fireworks went off beautifully.
Don’t go off without saying goodbye.
The bomb went off without warning.
She went off about how unfair the decision was.
The lights went off during the storm.
extraExampleTranslations: Sut buzilib qolgan — ichmang.
U o‘tgan yili kollejga ketdi.
Feyerverklar ajoyib portladi.
Xayrlashmasdan ketmang.
Bomba ogohlantirishsiz portladi.
U qaror qanchalik adolatsiz ekanligi haqida gapira boshladi.
Bo‘ron paytida chiroqlar o‘chdi.

words.definition: To try on clothes (especially formal or custom-made ones) to check the size and make adjustments if needed.
words.definitionUz: Kiyimlarni (ayniqsa rasmiy yoki buyurtma asosida tikilgan) o‘lchab ko‘rish va kerak bo‘lsa tuzatishlar kiritish.
words.example1: I have a fitting for my wedding dress tomorrow.
words.example1Translation: Ertaga to‘y ko‘ylagim uchun fitting bor.
words.example2: She has a fitting for the costume next week.
words.example2Translation: U keyingi hafta kostyum uchun fitting qiladi.
words.example3: Actors often have fittings before filming starts.
words.example3Translation: Aktyorlar suratga olish boshlanishidan oldin ko‘pincha fitting qiladilar.
extraExamples: I need to schedule a fitting for the suit.
The final fitting is scheduled for Friday.
She had three fittings before the dress was perfect.
Don’t forget your fitting appointment.
The tailor asked me to come for another fitting.
Having a proper fitting ensures the clothes fit well.
He went for a fitting after the measurements were taken.
extraExampleTranslations: Kostyum uchun fitting belgilashim kerak.
Yakuniy fitting juma kuniga rejalashtirilgan.
Ko‘ylak mukammal bo‘lgunga qadar u uch marta fitting qildi.
Fitting uchrashuvingizni unutmang.
Tikuvchi yana bir fittingga kelishimni so‘radi.
To‘g‘ri fitting kiyimlarning yaxshi o‘tirishini ta’minlaydi.
O‘lchovlar olingandan keyin u fittingga bordi.

words.definition: To remove an item of clothing or something that is covering or attached; also to deduct or reduce something.
words.definitionUz: Kiyim yoki qoplovchi / yopishtirilgan narsani yechib olish; shuningdek, biror narsani ayirish yoki kamaytirish.
words.example1: Please take your shoes off at the door.
words.example1Translation: Iltimos, eshik oldida oyoq kiyimlaringizni yeching.
words.example2: She took her jacket off because it was warm.
words.example2Translation: Issiq bo‘lgani uchun u kurtkasini yechib oldi.
words.example3: They took 20% off the price.
words.example3Translation: Ular narxdan 20 foiz chegirma qildilar.
extraExamples: Take your hat off when you enter the room.
He took the cover off the pot.
Can you take this stain off my shirt?
She took the day off from work.
Take the lid off carefully.
They took the old paint off the walls.
I need to take some weight off.
extraExampleTranslations: Xonaga kirganda shlyapangizni yeching.
U qozonning qopqog‘ini oldi.
Bu dog‘ni ko‘ylagimdan olib tashlay olasizmi?
U ishdan bir kunlik ta’til oldi.
Qopqog‘ini ehtiyotkorlik bilan oling.
Ular devorlardagi eski bo‘yoqni olib tashladilar.
Men biroz vazn tashlashim kerak.

words.definition: A polite way of saying that someone needs to use the toilet.
words.definitionUz: Kimdir hojatxonaga borishi kerakligini aytishning odobli usuli.
words.example1: Excuse me, I need to go to the bathroom.
words.example1Translation: Kechirasiz, hojatxonaga borishim kerak.
words.example2: The kids asked to go to the bathroom during the movie.
words.example2Translation: Bolalar film paytida hojatxonaga borishni so‘radilar.
words.example3: She went to the bathroom and came back quickly.
words.example3Translation: U hojatxonaga borib, tez qaytib keldi.
extraExamples: Is it okay if I go to the bathroom first?
He went to the bathroom three times during the meeting.
Please wait — I need to go to the bathroom.
The teacher allowed students to go to the bathroom one by one.
I always go to the bathroom before a long trip.
She excused herself to go to the bathroom.
Don’t forget to go to the bathroom before we leave.
extraExampleTranslations: Avval hojatxonaga borsam maylimi?
U yig‘ilish paytida uch marta hojatxonaga bordi.
Iltimos, kuting — hojatxonaga borishim kerak.
O‘qituvchi talabalarga birma-bir hojatxonaga borishga ruxsat berdi.
Uzoq safardan oldin har doim hojatxonaga boraman.
U hojatxonaga borish uchun uzr so‘radi.
Ketishdan oldin hojatxonaga borishni unutmang.

words.definition: To change or adjust something so that it feels better, easier, or more pleasant to use or be in.
words.definitionUz: Biror narsani o‘zgartirish yoki sozlash orqali uni yanada qulay, oson yoki yoqimli qilish.
words.example1: We added pillows to make the sofa more comfortable.
words.example1Translation: Divanni yanada qulay qilish uchun yostiqlar qo‘shdik.
words.example2: He adjusted the chair to make it more comfortable.
words.example2Translation: U stulni yanada qulay qilish uchun sozladi.
words.example3: They redesigned the office to make it more comfortable for employees.
words.example3Translation: Ular ofisni xodimlar uchun yanada qulay qilish uchun qayta dizayn qildilar.
extraExamples: Can you make the temperature more comfortable?
She moved the furniture to make the room more comfortable.
Adding soft lighting can make a space more comfortable.
I want to make my workspace more comfortable.
They changed the seats to make the journey more comfortable.
Small changes can make a big difference in comfort.
He tried to make the conversation more comfortable.
extraExampleTranslations: Haroratni yanada qulay qila olasizmi?
U xonani yanada qulay qilish uchun mebellarni ko‘chirdi.
Yumshoq yoritish joyini yanada qulay qilishi mumkin.
Men ish joyimni yanada qulay qilishni xohlayman.
Ular sayohatni yanada qulay qilish uchun o‘rindiqlarni almashtirdilar.
Kichik o‘zgarishlar qulaylikda katta farq qilishi mumkin.
U suhbatni yanada qulay qilishga harakat qildi.

words.definition: Every day; happening or done regularly each day.
words.definitionUz: Har kuni; har kuni muntazam ravishda sodir bo‘ladigan yoki bajariladigan.
words.example1: I exercise on a daily basis.
words.example1Translation: Men har kuni sport bilan shug‘ullanaman.
words.example2: She checks her email on a daily basis.
words.example2Translation: U har kuni elektron pochtasini tekshiradi.
words.example3: We communicate with clients on a daily basis.
words.example3Translation: Biz mijozlar bilan har kuni muloqot qilamiz.
extraExamples: He reads the news on a daily basis.
Mistakes happen on a daily basis in this job.
They update the website on a daily basis.
I try to learn something new on a daily basis.
The problem occurs on a daily basis.
She practices the piano on a daily basis.
We deal with customer complaints on a daily basis.
extraExampleTranslations: U har kuni yangiliklarni o‘qiydi.
Bu ishda xatolar har kuni sodir bo‘ladi.
Ular veb-saytni har kuni yangilab turadilar.
Men har kuni yangi narsa o‘rganishga harakat qilaman.
Muammo har kuni yuzaga keladi.
U har kuni pianino chalishni mashq qiladi.
Biz mijozlar shikoyatlari bilan har kuni shug‘ullanamiz.

words.definition: Involving communication or direct involvement between people or systems; engaging with someone or something in a two-way manner. (Note: commonly “interact with”.)
words.definitionUz: Odamlar yoki tizimlar o‘rtasida muloqot yoki bevosita ishtirokni o‘z ichiga oladi; kimdir yoki biror narsa bilan ikki tomonlama muloqot qilish. (Eslatma: odatda “interact with” deb aytiladi.)
words.translation: Bilan o‘zaro ta’sir qilmoq / muloqot qilmoq
words.example1: The app is designed to be interactive with users.
words.example1Translation: Ilova foydalanuvchilar bilan o‘zaro ta’sir qilish uchun mo‘ljallangan.
words.example2: Children learn better when they are interactive with the material.
words.example2Translation: Bolalar material bilan o‘zaro ta’sir qilganda yaxshiroq o‘rganadilar.
words.example3: She is very interactive with her audience during presentations.
words.example3Translation: U taqdimotlar paytida auditoriya bilan juda faol muloqot qiladi.
extraExamples: The teacher is interactive with the students.
Modern games are highly interactive with players.
He tries to be interactive with every customer.
The website allows users to be interactive with content.
Being interactive with the community builds trust.
The exhibition is interactive with visitors.
Good leaders are interactive with their teams.
extraExampleTranslations: O‘qituvchi o‘quvchilar bilan faol muloqot qiladi.
Zamonaviy o‘yinlar o‘yinchilar bilan yuqori darajada o‘zaro ta’sir qiladi.
U har bir mijoz bilan muloqot qilishga harakat qiladi.
Veb-sayt foydalanuvchilarga kontent bilan o‘zaro ta’sir qilish imkonini beradi.
Jamoa bilan o‘zaro ta’sir qilish ishonchni mustahkamlaydi.
Ko‘rgazma tashrif buyuruvchilar bilan interaktiv.
Yaxshi rahbarlar jamoalari bilan faol muloqot qiladilar.

words.definition: Special honor or respect shown publicly; something done to show respect or admiration for someone or something, often in art or film.
words.definitionUz: Ommaviy ravishda ko‘rsatiladigan maxsus hurmat yoki ehtirom; kimdir yoki biror narsaga hurmat yoki hayratni bildirish uchun qilingan narsa, ko‘pincha san’at yoki filmlarda.
words.example1: The film is an homage to classic 1980s movies.
words.example1Translation: Film 1980-yillardagi klassik filmlarga hurmat sifatida yaratilgan.
words.example2: They paid homage to the great artist with a special exhibition.
words.example2Translation: Ular buyuk rassomga maxsus ko‘rgazma bilan hurmat bajo keltirdilar.
words.example3: This song is an homage to her favorite singer.
words.example3Translation: Bu qo‘shiq uning sevimli qo‘shiqchisiga hurmatdir.
extraExamples: The director included many homages to older films.
We paid homage to the victims of the tragedy.
His work is full of homage to traditional styles.
The ceremony was an homage to the country’s history.
She created the piece as an homage to her mentor.
The book is an homage to classic detective stories.
Fans saw the scene as a clear homage to the original.
extraExampleTranslations: Rejissyor eski filmlarga ko‘p hurmatlarni kiritdi.
Biz fojia qurbonlariga hurmat bajo keltirdik.
Uning asari an’anaviy uslublarga hurmat bilan to‘la.
Marosim mamlakat tarixiga hurmat edi.
U asarni o‘z mentoriga hurmat sifatida yaratdi.
Kitob klassik detektiv hikoyalarga hurmatdir.
Muxlislar sahnani asl asarga aniq hurmat deb ko‘rdilar.

words.definition: To have clothing, jewelry, or other items on your body; also to become damaged or thinner through use.
words.definitionUz: Kiyim, zargarlik buyumlari yoki boshqa narsalarni tanangizda tutish; shuningdek, foydalanish tufayli shikastlanish yoki yupqalashish.
words.example1: She always wears elegant clothes.
words.example1Translation: U har doim nafis kiyimlar kiyadi.
words.example2: I don’t wear jewelry very often.
words.example2Translation: Men zargarlik buyumlarini unchalik ko‘p taqmayman.
words.example3: These shoes are starting to wear out.
words.example3Translation: Bu oyoq kiyimlar eskirib bormoqda.
extraExamples: He wears glasses for reading.
What are you going to wear to the party?
She wears a uniform to work every day.
The carpet is beginning to wear in the middle.
I prefer to wear comfortable shoes.
He wears his success lightly.
Don’t wear that shirt — it’s dirty.
extraExampleTranslations: U o‘qish uchun ko‘zoynak taqadi.
Bayramga nima kiyasiz?
U har kuni ishga forma kiyadi.
Gilam o‘rtasidan eskirib bormoqda.
Men qulay oyoq kiyimlarni kiyishni afzal ko‘raman.
U o‘z muvaffaqiyatini oddiy qabul qiladi.
O‘sha ko‘ylakni kiyma — u iflos.

words.definition: To act or speak on behalf of someone or something; to stand for or symbolize something; to depict or show something.
words.definitionUz: Kimdir yoki biror narsa nomidan harakat qilish yoki gapirish; biror narsani anglatish yoki ramziy qilish; biror narsani tasvirlash yoki ko‘rsatish.
words.example1: She represents the company at international meetings.
words.example1Translation: U xalqaro yig‘ilishlarda kompaniyani vakillik qiladi.
words.example2: The color red often represents passion.
words.example2Translation: Qizil rang ko‘pincha ehtirosni ifodalaydi.
words.example3: This painting represents a peaceful countryside.
words.example3Translation: Bu rasm tinch qishloq manzarasini tasvirlaydi.
extraExamples: Lawyers represent their clients in court.
The flag represents the nation’s identity.
He was chosen to represent his school in the competition.
These statistics represent real people’s lives.
Art can represent complex emotions.
She represents everything I admire.
The data does not fully represent the situation.
extraExampleTranslations: Advokatlar sudda o‘z mijozlarini vakillik qiladilar.
Bayroq millatning o‘ziga xosligini ifodalaydi.
U maktabini musobaqada vakillik qilish uchun tanlandi.
Bu statistika haqiqiy odamlarning hayotini ifodalaydi.
San’at murakkab his-tuyg‘ularni ifodalashi mumkin.
U men hayratlanadigan hamma narsani ifodalaydi.
Ma’lumotlar vaziyatni to‘liq ifodalamaydi.

words.definition: To be physically fit and healthy; also to be in excellent condition (for objects or situations).
words.definitionUz: Jismonan sog‘lom va formada bo‘lish; shuningdek, (narsalar yoki vaziyatlar uchun) a’lo holatda bo‘lish.
words.translation: A’lo formada bo‘lmoq / zo‘r holatda bo‘lmoq
words.example1: She exercises every day and is in great shape.
words.example1Translation: U har kuni sport bilan shug‘ullanadi va a’lo formada.
words.example2: The car is old but still in great shape.
words.example2Translation: Mashina eski, lekin hali ham a’lo holatda.
words.example3: After the diet, he is in great shape.
words.example3Translation: Parhezdan keyin u a’lo formada.
extraExamples: I want to be in great shape before summer.
The team is in great shape for the finals.
Despite his age, he is in great shape.
The house is in great shape after the renovation.
Regular exercise keeps you in great shape.
She looks like she’s in great shape.
The project is in great shape and on schedule.
extraExampleTranslations: Yozga qadar a’lo formada bo‘lishni xohlayman.
Jamoa final uchun a’lo formada.
Yoshiga qaramay, u a’lo formada.
Uy ta’mirdan keyin a’lo holatda.
Muntazam sport sizni a’lo formada ushlab turadi.
U a’lo formada ko‘rinadi.
Loyiha a’lo holatda va jadval bo‘yicha.

words.definition: A person or thing that is preferred or most often chosen because it is reliable or suitable.
words.definitionUz: Ishonchli yoki mos bo‘lgani uchun afzal ko‘riladigan yoki eng ko‘p tanlanadigan odam yoki narsa.
words.example1: This restaurant is my go-to place for pizza.
words.example1Translation: Bu restoran pizza uchun mening asosiy tanlovim.
words.example2: She is the go-to person for advice in the office.
words.example2Translation: U ofisda maslahat uchun eng ishonchli odam.
words.example3: Black is my go-to color for formal events.
words.example3Translation: Qora rang rasmiy tadbirlar uchun mening asosiy tanlovim.
extraExamples: This app is my go-to for learning languages.
He is the go-to expert on this topic.
Jeans are my go-to outfit for casual days.
That’s my go-to excuse when I’m late.
This tool is the go-to solution for the problem.
Coffee is my go-to drink in the morning.
She has become the go-to designer for many celebrities.
extraExampleTranslations: Bu ilova tillarni o‘rganish uchun mening asosiy tanlovim.
U bu mavzu bo‘yicha eng ishonchli mutaxassis.
Jinsi shim oddiy kunlar uchun mening asosiy kiyimim.
Bu men kechikkanimda aytadigan asosiy bahonam.
Bu vosita muammo uchun asosiy yechim.
Qahva ertalab mening asosiy ichimligim.
U ko‘p mashhurlar uchun asosiy dizaynerga aylandi.

words.definition: To place or arrange two layers of something on top of each other; in informal contexts, sometimes used for combining two items (e.g., two burgers).
words.definitionUz: Biror narsaning ikki qatlamini bir-birining ustiga qo‘yish yoki joylashtirish; norasmiy kontekstda ba’zan ikki narsani birlashtirish uchun ishlatiladi (masalan, ikki burger).
words.translation: Ikki qavat qilib qo‘ymoq / dubl stack qilmoq
words.example1: They decided to double stack the burgers for a bigger meal.
words.example1Translation: Ular kattaroq ovqat uchun burgerlarni ikki qavat qilishga qaror qildilar.
words.example2: You can double stack the boxes to save space.
words.example2Translation: Joy tejash uchun qutilarni ikki qavat qilib qo‘yishingiz mumkin.
words.example3: The sandwich is double stacked with cheese and meat.
words.example3Translation: Sendvich pishloq va go‘sht bilan ikki qavat qilingan.
extraExamples: Let’s double stack the pancakes with syrup.
The shelves allow you to double stack the products.
He ordered a double stacked burger.
Be careful not to double stack heavy items.
They double stacked the mattresses in the truck.
Double stacking can make the portion look bigger.
The design allows users to double stack modules.
extraExampleTranslations: Pancake’larni sirop bilan ikki qavat qilaylik.
Tokchalar mahsulotlarni ikki qavat qilib qo‘yishga imkon beradi.
U ikki qavatli burger buyurtma qildi.
Og‘ir narsalarni ikki qavat qilib qo‘ymaslikka ehtiyot bo‘ling.
Ular yuk mashinasida matraslarni ikki qavat qildilar.
Ikki qavat qilish porsiyani kattaroq ko‘rsatishi mumkin.
Dizayn foydalanuvchilarga modullarni ikki qavat qilish imkonini beradi.

words.definition: Good enough to be accepted, allowed, or approved; satisfactory or adequate.
words.definitionUz: Qabul qilinishi, ruxsat etilishi yoki ma’qullanishi uchun yetarli darajada yaxshi; qoniqarli yoki munosib.
words.example1: Your work is acceptable, but it could be better.
words.example1Translation: Ishingiz qabul qilinadigan, lekin yanada yaxshiroq bo‘lishi mumkin.
words.example2: Is this level of noise acceptable in the office?
words.example2Translation: Ofisda bu darajadagi shovqin qabul qilinadiganmi?
words.example3: The proposal was considered acceptable by the committee.
words.example3Translation: Taklif qo‘mita tomonidan qabul qilinadigan deb topildi.
extraExamples: We need to find an acceptable solution for everyone.
His behavior is not acceptable in this workplace.
The quality of the product is acceptable for the price.
Is it acceptable to arrive a few minutes late?
She set clear and acceptable boundaries.
The risk level is acceptable under the circumstances.
Only acceptable forms of identification will be allowed.
extraExampleTranslations: Hamma uchun qabul qilinadigan yechim topishimiz kerak.
Uning xulq-atvori bu ish joyida qabul qilinmaydi.
Mahsulot sifati narxiga nisbatan qabul qilinadigan.
Bir necha daqiqa kechikib kelish qabul qilinadiganmi?
U aniq va qabul qilinadigan chegaralar belgiladi.
Xavf darajasi sharoitga ko‘ra qabul qilinadigan.
Faqat qabul qilinadigan identifikatsiya shakllariga ruxsat beriladi.
